## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture the edge from a pre-break twin-rejection put detector. This detector will help identify potential breakdowns in the market and provide a signal for entering a trade. The hypothesis is that this detector will beat a random-entry null by at least 2 sigma on real OPRA fills before any paper or live consideration.

## Mechanism

The mechanism for this detector involves implementing a reusable is_shooting_star + new vol_expansion + same-level clustering. This will be run over the period of 2024-01-01 to 2026-06-28, with an expected 60-150 fires. The null hypothesis will be tested against two scenarios: (1) random entry on any bar matching certain conditions, and (2) a single-shooting-star rejection.
